questions.question: Which dependency gives Spring Boot the ability to talk to a MySQL server?
options: mysql-connector-j with runtime scope
h2 with runtime scope
spring-boot-starter-webmvc
hibernate-mysql-server
questions.explanation: The JDBC driver mysql-connector-j is what speaks the MySQL protocol, and Spring Boot manages its version.

questions.question: What is the job of the HikariCP pool that Spring Boot creates?
options: It stores your entities in memory instead of MySQL
It creates the MySQL server if it is missing
It keeps a few connections open so requests can borrow and return them
It converts SQL into Java objects
questions.explanation: A pool avoids the cost of opening a new connection for every request.

questions.question: With spring.datasource.password=${DB_PASSWORD} and no DB_PASSWORD variable set, what happens at startup?
options: The app connects with an empty password
Startup fails because the placeholder cannot be resolved
Spring Boot falls back to the password root
The app starts and prints a warning only
questions.explanation: A placeholder without a default value must exist, or Spring throws an error while reading the properties.

questions.question: The app fails with Communications link failure on jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/clinic. What is the most likely cause?
options: The entity is missing a getter
The repository extends the wrong interface
ddl-auto is set to update
The MySQL server is not running or the host and port are wrong
questions.explanation: This error means the driver could not reach the server at all, so check that MySQL is up and the URL is right.

questions.question: MySQL says Unknown database clinic when the app starts. What is the fix?
options: Set ddl-auto to update
Add @Entity to the main class
Create the database first with CREATE DATABASE clinic
Change the port to 8080
questions.explanation: Hibernate creates tables, but it does not create the database itself, so it must already exist.
